title: Hard-bound design: resident-source warp CPU-compatible Q8_0 hot-batch compare kernel

minimum_bandwidth_math.practical_kernel_bandwidth_target_gib_s: 400-550 after reserving time for H2D, D2H, launch/sync, scatter/compare, and safety margin

kernel_design.default_behavior: unchanged; env unset keeps accepted path and existing scalar compare behavior
kernel_design.execution_point: after normal CPU fallback inside HOT_BATCH_PROBE_COMPARE, with CPU dst authoritative
kernel_design.logit_effect: none; compare probe does not write final dst or clear CPU fallback counts
kernel_design.mapping: Use one warp for two output elements. Each half-warp maps one output dot product to 16 CUDA lanes: lanes 0-7 accumulate CPU accum1[0..7], lanes 8-15 accumulate CPU accum2[0..7]. Lanes 16-31 compute a second output the same way.
kernel_design.bit_exact_rule: For each output, keep the block-pair loop sequential in ib order. Each lane applies fmaf(scale, p_lane, acc_lane) in the same order as the CPU AVX path. Lane 0 or 16 gathers the 16 lane accumulators and applies the same hsum order as moe_stream_q80_cpu_compat_hsum8.
kernel_design.expected_gain_vs_scalar: The scalar kernel under-occupies each per-op launch and serializes all 16 CPU accumulator lanes inside one thread. The warp design increases per-op parallelism and moves the 16 accumulator lanes into CUDA lanes while preserving reduction order.
known_limits: No source layout transpose is included in the first probe, so resident source loads may remain poorly coalesced.
No pinned staging is included in the first raw kernel probe, so H2D/D2H totals from that probe are not the final path.
The route remains conditional on async source/page overlap; a passing kernel probe alone does not prove 10 tok/s.

probe_sequence.pass: process exits 0, compare_ok for all compare_ran records, op-level max_abs=0, no OOM/no swap

probe_sequence.env: same plus COMPARE_MAX_RECORDS=512 on fixed-text llama-results
probe_sequence.pass: same_top1=145/145, first_mismatch_pos=-1, op-level max_abs=0, no OOM/no swap
projected raw kernel time for full ready set below about 250 ms before investing in pinned/persistent staging

probe_sequence.condition: only if raw kernel projection passes
probe_sequence.pass: combined projected H2D+kernel+D2H+scatter+launch/sync <=446.414 ms with margin

rejection_rules: Reject no-layout-change warp route if compare max_abs != 0 in CPU-compatible mode.
Reject before strict cold performance if fixed-text top1 does not pass.
Reject before persistent staging if projected raw kernel time is >=250 ms.
Reject before SOTA performance if combined projected overhead exceeds 446.414 ms or if additional workspace threatens the 16GB RAM/page-cache or observed VRAM margins.
Reject any strict cold promotion unless eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, 16GB cgroup including page cache holds, no swap/OOM, and France output is semantically correct and coherent.
